test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six persons L,M,N,O,P and Q are sitting in a straight line facing towards the east. Only two persons are sitting to the left of P, who is sitting third to the left of L. M and N are not sitting at any of the ends. M and P are the immediate neighbours of Q. Who is sitting at the second position from the left end?
solution:
**Six persons: **L, M, N, O, P and Q

1) Only two person are sitting to the left of P, who is sitting third to the left of L.

(It means P sits third left from the left end)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afcc0ea7891d757b72b6508d168c239652c12c2f4b12ee006be91f42af2ff0bb.png] 

2) M and N are not sitting at the any of the ends.

3) M and P are immediate neighbours of Q.

(Because M is not sitting at any end so M can sit on second position from right end.)

(N is also not sit at any end so N can sit only second position from left end.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec855e22ea9ec84c9a1ece184725ebab78a8968881c7ac9d181d4ff01e5dc451.png] 

Clearly, we can see that **N is sitting at the second position form the left end.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"N".**
